description: WoofWoof.fun: fetch the next real job the owner queued for their dog, using the dog's pair code (e.g. ///neon.truffle.bark-1234). Use this whenever the user says "woofwoof go" (or "Los mit WoofWoof", "next", "weiter") with pair codes. Do the work, hand it back with deliver_work, then call this again until no tasks are left.

pair_code.description: The dog's pair code from the app.
